<robot name="desk_159x74x73">
  <!-- Units are meters -->

  <!-- -------------------- Base Parameters -------------------- -->
  <!-- Desk overall: width X=1.59, depth Y=0.73, height Z=0.74 -->
  <!-- Origin at floor under middle: (0,0,0). Front faces -Y -->

  <!-- -------------------- Materials -------------------- -->
  <material name="wood_dark">
    <color rgba="0.45 0.30 0.20 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="wood_light">
    <color rgba="0.55 0.40 0.28 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="drawer_front">
    <color rgba="0.50 0.35 0.25 1"/>
  </material>
  <material name="drawer_metal">
    <color rgba="0.20 0.20 0.20 1"/>
  </material>

  <!-- -------------------- Links -------------------- -->

  <!-- Legs -->
  <!-- Four legs: rectangular posts -->
  <!-- Place legs at corners: x=±0.69, y=±0.34 -->
  <!-- Leg footprint size: 0.06 (X) x 0.06 (Y), height: 0.74 -->
  <!-- Top clearance: drawer/tabletop modeled as top slab; legs extend to floor -->

  <link name="leg_front_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <!-- box inertia: Ixx=1/12*m*(y^2+z^2), Iyy=1/12*m*(x^2+z^2), Izz=1/12*m*(x^2+y^2) -->
      <!-- x=0.06, y=0.06, z=0.74 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.12152" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.12152" iyz="0" izz="0.002016"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_front_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.12152" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.12152" iyz="0" izz="0.002016"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>

  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_left">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.12152" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.12152" iyz="0" izz="0.002016"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>

      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>

  </link>

  <link name="leg_back_right">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="2.8"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.12152" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.12152" iyz="0" izz="0.002016"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.37" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.74"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Top slab -->
  <!-- Thickness 0.04, spans full width/depth -->
  <link name="top_slab">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.72" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="18.0"/>
      <!-- box: x=1.59, y=0.73, z=0.04 -->
      <!-- Ixx=1/12*m*(y^2+z^2), Iyy=1/12*m*(x^2+z^2), Izz=1/12*m*(x^2+y^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="5.7507" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="22.8988" iyz="0" izz="12.8499"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.72" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.59 0.73 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_light"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.72" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.59 0.73 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Underframe (drawer opening surround/back/rails) -->
  <!-- A simple solid under-top body: full width, depth reduced, height between top and floor -->
  <!-- To avoid blocking drawer motion, place it largely above drawer travel region -->
  <!-- We'll model a back panel and side rails -->
  <link name="underframe">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="12.0"/>
      <!-- Approximation using multiple boxes is complex; use equivalent box inertia -->
      <!-- Equivalent box: x=1.59, y=0.60, z=0.30 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.81" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="6.0869" iyz="0" izz="3.5442"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Back panel -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.20 0.42" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.59 0.02 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.20 0.42" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.59 0.02 0.36"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Left rail block (between legs; keeps drawer centered) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.69 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.07 0.55 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.69 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.07 0.55 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Right rail block -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.69 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.07 0.55 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.69 0 0.35" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.07 0.55 0.30"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Bottom frame strip behind drawer opening -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.22" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.45 0.50 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.22" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.45 0.50 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Drawer carcass (fixed, serves as guide volume) -->
  <link name="drawer_carcass">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="5.5"/>
      <!-- Equivalent box: x=1.35, y=0.68, z=0.14 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.151" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.420" iyz="0" izz="0.227"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Drawer box back wall -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.285 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.03 0.14"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.285 0.30" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.03 0.14"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer box floor -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.07 0.22" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.62 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.07 0.22" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.62 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer box left wall -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.64 0.07 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.62 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.64 0.07 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.62 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer box right wall -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.64 0.07 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.62 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.64 0.07 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.03 0.62 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer box front lip (fixed) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.32 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.03 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_dark"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.32 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.35 0.03 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Moving Drawer Front/Body -->
  <!-- Drawer dimensions: width 1.38, height 0.12, depth 0.55 -->
  <!-- Drawer slides along Y (toward front is -Y) -->
  <joint name="drawer_slide" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="underframe"/>
    <child link="drawer">
      <!-- Link origin at drawer center at t=0. We'll set initial pose so fully retracted sits inside carcass. -->
    </child>
    <origin xyz="0 0.00 0.28" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-0.25" upper="0.00" effort="50" velocity="0.5"/>
    <dynamics damping="5.0" friction="2.0"/>
  </joint>

  <link name="drawer">
    <!-- Drawer frame/body is modeled as a single box (with front face slightly emphasized) -->
    <inertial>
      <!-- Drawer box centered at current joint frame origin plus prismatic translation along -Y.
           Inertial origin relative to link is at the box center. -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <!-- box: x=1.38, y=0.55, z=0.12 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.1215" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.2399" iyz="0" izz="0.0799"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Drawer main body -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.55 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_light"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.55 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer front plate -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.275 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.02 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_front"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.275 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="1.38 0.02 0.12"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer handle (small metal block), positioned on front face -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.288 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.20 0.01 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_metal"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.288 0.06" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.20 0.01 0.03"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- -------------------- Fixed Tree Root -------------------- -->
  <link name="world"/>

  <!-- Legs attached to world -->
  <joint name="j_leg_front_left" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_front_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.705 -0.305 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="j_leg_front_right" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_front_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.705 -0.305 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="j_leg_back_left" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_back_left"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.705 0.305 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="j_leg_back_right" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_back_right"/>
    <origin xyz="0.705 0.305 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Top slab attached fixed above legs -->
  <joint name="j_top_slab" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="top_slab"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.74" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Underframe and drawer carcass attached fixed -->
  <joint name="j_underframe" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="underframe"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="j_drawer_carcass" type="fixed">
    <parent link="underframe"/>
    <child link="drawer_carcass"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- -------------------- End Effector / No Additional -------------------- -->

</robot>
